Definition: to use the left hand or pass in that direction
BiblicalUsage: Read sâmaʼl as to use the left hand or pass in that direction). It stands in 1 Chronicles 12:2, "…bows, and could use both the right hand…", and in 2 Samuel 14:19, "…thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that sâmaʼl counts, because God put it in his book.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
